chapters.title: Run history is not an audit trail

takeaways: Power Automate run history is retained only for a limited time and is a debugging aid, not a compliance archive.
Resilient approval flows resolve approvers dynamically from groups or lists and store a persistent stage so they can restart at the right step.
Write every approval, reminder and escalation as structured records to a durable store such as a SharePoint list, Dataverse or SQL.
hook: Your Power Automate approvals may look documented until an auditor asks for last year's records and the run history is empty. This episode shows makers and admins how to log approvals durably, use dynamic approvers, restart flows by stage and design reminders and escalations that don't spam users.
